assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase7_transfer_bound
assertions.source: Transfer-error bound: g'(0)=Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)<0 and |Taylor remainder|/|linear| =|r−1|<1 (max 0.46), all n≤14 at 40dps ⇒ non-Gaussian correction cannot flip the sign. NQD eliminated (Hoeffding kernel >0 pointwise). Rigorous bound needs Plancherel-cumulant control of g^(m)(0). No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 7 (effective-Stein) STEP 2 of the covariance-kernel epic (qou-x631): the transfer-error BOUND. With g(θ)=E_{2+θ}[ω₃] (dimension-tilted mean; g^{(m)}(0)=mixed Plancherel cumulants κ_{m+1}(ln f;…;ω₃)), g(0)=0, g(1)=kernel (∝cov(n)), g'(0)=Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)=Gaussian main term. Taylor: g(1)=g'(0)+R, R=Σ_{m≥2}g^{(m)}(0)/m!. So kernel≤0 ⇐ [g'(0)≤0] AND [|R|<|g'(0)|]. BOUND HOLDS (40dps, n≤14): g'(0)<0 all n; transfer ratio r=g(1)/g'(0)∈(0.54,0.87) ⇒ |R|/|g'(0)|=|r−1|∈(0.13,0.46)<1 — the non-Gaussian correction is ≤~46% of the linear term, never flips the sign. NQD route ELIMINATED: the Hoeffding kernel H(s,t)=P(ln f>s,ω₃>t)−P(ln f>s)P(ω₃>t) is >0 at some thresholds (bad count grows with n; worst H≈+0.13), so there is no pointwise negative-quadrant-dependence certificate. NET: kernel reduces to two concrete analytic targets [Cov(ln f,ω₃)≤0] and [|remainder|<|linear|], both verified numerically; rigorous bound needs Plancherel-cumulant control of g^{(m)}(0) (Kerov CLT) — the open core. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
